profile.name: Jafsal M A
profile.headline: Senior Python Developer | Technical Lead | Data Engineering & Web Scraping
profile.summary: I build web crawling and data pipelines at scale, turning messy, high-volume, multi-source data into reliable, structured feeds for downstream analytics. Over 7+ years specialising in large-scale scraping fleets, distributed ingestion pipelines, and agentic AI tooling.

about.intro: I build web crawling and data pipelines at scale, turning messy, high-volume, multi-source data into reliable, structured feeds for downstream analytics.
specialisations: Large-scale Scrapy/Scrapyd fleets, anti-bot evasion, and API reverse-engineering
Distributed ingestion pipelines (ArangoDB, Elasticsearch, Cassandra) with fault tolerance and schema evolution
ETL/ELT orchestration (Apache NiFi), with PySpark and Airflow in active use
Leading and mentoring engineering teams (currently leading 4) through code review, architecture, and delivery
about.recent: Most recently at PST.AG (Germany, remote), I've also been building agentic AI tooling — automation agents in the Hermes framework with MCP integration — alongside the core scraping/data engineering work.
about.closing: I'm always happy to connect with people working on data extraction, anti-bot systems, or distributed data infrastructure.

experience.role: Python Developer / Team Lead – Data Engineering & Web Scraping
bullets: Led design and delivery of Python backend tooling powering 400K+ daily executions, improving ingestion throughput and downstream data readiness for analytics

Led the Data Operations team for one year, owning the full ETL project lifecycle — crawling, transformation, and automated delivery — with outputs delivered to clients in SAP XML, E4H XML, and other structured formats
Built and scaled ingestion pipelines across distributed storage (ArangoDB, Elasticsearch) to process high-volume multi-source feeds with fault tolerance and schema evolution support
Optimized the automated file-delivery script used to ship customer deliverables on each release, improving delivery reliability and reducing manual intervention
Implemented automated validation and scenario-based verification, increasing detected data anomalies and reducing incorrect downstream records by measurable rates
Designed and operated ETL workflows using Apache NiFi for ingestion, transformation, routing, and automated validation of heterogeneous data streams
Contributed to project planning and execution, translating client and stakeholder requirements into scoped, deliverable technical work
Completed onboarding for the company's transition into agentic AI and joined the team building automation agents on the Hermes framework, integrating MCP and Mattermost for operational communication
Led a team of 4 engineers, conducting code reviews, mentoring, and spearheading internal tooling and performance optimization POCs to raise team productivity
Maintained containerized services on Docker and Linux infrastructure, integrating releases into CI/CD pipelines for versioned rollouts and monitoring
Participated in Agile ceremonies and delivery tracking via Jira to maintain sprint velocity and transparency

experience.role: Software Engineer II – Data Operations and Engineering
bullets: Architected Python and Golang backend systems that processed millions of records daily, improving pipeline throughput and operational reliability
Reverse-engineered Android applications to discover internal endpoints and integrate RESTful APIs into structured pipelines, using BrowserStack and LambdaTest for cross-device testing and validation
Designed and enforced automated verification pipelines and data quality checks to ensure correctness across extracted datasets
Operated distributed storage and messaging to support high-throughput workflows, using Elasticsearch, Cassandra, and RabbitMQ
Automated operational workflows with Bash, Cron, and Jenkins, reducing manual failures and deployment errors
Mentored junior engineers and maintained system stability through proactive monitoring, debugging, and incident resolution
Architected modular C++ services for Azure IoT Edge to enable reliable, low-latency processing across distributed edge environments
Delivered Dockerized services and automated builds using Azure DevOps and Git to support continuous integration and deployment
Implemented protocol-heavy solutions with strict validation requirements to ensure compliance and system integrity in regulated environments
Developed Python ETL crawlers using Scrapy and BeautifulSoup to extract, clean, and transform e-commerce data supporting downstream analytics and ML feature pipelines
Built parsing and feature-extraction logic that improved data completeness and reduced downstream cleaning effort, leveraging regular expressions and pandas for transformation
Documented crawling workflows, contributed to code review processes, and supported knowledge transfer to maintainable scraping codebases
